name: video-ads-codex-claude-code
title_zh: 双AI联审视频广告，从钩子到复盘全流程
tagline_zh: Codex发起，Claude Code交叉审片，双脑协作产出脚本、分镜、配音、音乐提示词，还带战役复盘。
tagline_en: Codex kicks off, Claude Code cross-reviews. Scripts, storyboards, voice, music prompts, and campaign.
desc_en: Complete a video advertising mission jointly with real Codex and Claude Code, launched from Codex. Includes the integrated second brain, retention research, hooks, scripts, storyboards, voice, music, generation prompting, assembly, cross-review and campaign learning. Use when both assistants are requested for video ad work.
why_zh: 不是单模型一条龙，而是双AI交叉互审，机制上杜绝盲区，让广告创意经得起第二双眼睛的挑剔。
why_en: Not one-model assembly line. Dual-AI cross-review structurally eliminates blind spots, giving your ad creative a second critical.
limit_zh: 需同时安装Codex和Claude Code并配置好API密钥；只覆盖视频广告任务，不处理图文或纯音频。
limit_en: Requires both Codex and Claude Code with API keys. Covers video ads only; outputs up to editing scripts and prompts, not final video files.
title_en: Two-AI Video Ad Pipeline: Hooks to Retrospective
